title: A hospital worker’s $15.99 Goodwill find was identified as a Le Pho painting worth up to $80,000
summary_full: An occupational therapist found a painting for $15.99 at Goodwill while shopping to relieve stress. Notably, the piece was valued significantly higher during an appraisal on Antiques Roadshow. Fine-art expert Betty Krulik identified it as a work by Vietnamese artist Le Pho. The appraisal revealed that similar artworks could sell for between $60,000 and $80,000 at auction. This exceptional find highlights the importance of expert evaluations in determining art value.
